videos.caption: Figure AI has decommissioned its F.02 humanoid fleet by training the robots to leap autonomously into molten steel at a foundry in Imatra, Finland, a send-off Arnold Schwarzenegger suggested on X. The company says it had to destroy the robots to protect its IP after foundries in the US and Mexico refused to take machines with lithium-ion batteries, and it is turning the recovered metal into commemorative artifacts.

A new viral clip shows a man testing his AI humanoid at home — and it’s chaos. The robot stumbles, drops dishes, and accidentally smashes a mirror while trying to “help” clean. It’s part comedy, part cautionary tale. For now, buying a humanoid still feels like joining a beta test with legs. The video is a reminder that even with all the hype, real-world AI still struggles with real-world physics. A humanoid robot inside a Russian electronics store appeared to fight back after being pushed by a customer. CCTV footage shows the robot moving aggressively toward people inside the store, swinging its arms and kicking as several customers attempt to restrain it. The robot, nicknamed Sёma, had reportedly been introduced by the store as a humanoid “tech consultant” designed to interact with customers. What remains unclear is exactly what caused the response. There is currently no solid evidence confirming whether the robot was acting autonomously, following a programmed behaviour, being remotely controlled, or whether the incident was staged. Either way, footage of a humanoid robot physically clashing with people inside a store is a glimpse of a problem we may see far more often as robots enter public spaces. Would you trust one of these working around you? #Robot #robots #robotics #ai #artificialintelligence

The Sad Robot That Can’t Stop Working Can't Help Myself is a robotic art installation by Sun Yuan and Peng Yu. It features an industrial robotic arm trapped inside a glass enclosure, constantly pushing a red liquid back toward the center of the floor. Because the liquid keeps spreading, the robot is forced to repeat the task endlessly, symbolizing themes like endless work, control, and exhaustion. #shorts #interestingfacts #unique
